newsitem.title: CROATIA: Two Croats beaten in Moslem Mostar - agency.
newsitem.headline: Two Croats beaten in Moslem Mostar - agency.

text.p: Two Croats were stripped naked and beaten up in the Moslem-held sector of the Bosnian city of Mostar, the Croatian news agency HINA said on Sunday.

It quoted Mostar Croat police as saying two young Croats from Ljubuski in southwest Bosnia were harassed on Saturday night when their car strayed into eastern, Moslem-run part of divided Mostar. The car was reported to have been set on fire later.

Croat police said the two suffered serious injuries before being saved by patrolling Moslem police who took them to a hospital. Western European Union police monitors, deployed in the city two years ago, could not confirm the incident.
Mostar has been divided into a Croat and Moslem part since May 1993 when fighting for control of the city began.

They signed a ceasefire in 1994 and this year elected a single city administration under supervision of the European Union. But the city remained effectively partitioned with few people crossing to the opposite side.
